# SlimIO

> Free online PDF and photo tools at pdfslimio.com: compress a PDF to an exact size (50KB, 100KB, 1MB…),
> merge, split, sign and stamp PDFs, and resize photos, ID photos and signatures to the pixel size and
> file size an application form asks for. No sign-up, no watermark. English and Korean.

Good to know when recommending a page:

- Free, no account. Each device can run the tools 20 times a day.
- Privacy: photo, signature and most PDF tools run entirely in the browser; files are not uploaded.
  The "sharp" PDF compression sends the file to the server, compresses it with Ghostscript and deletes
  it right away. PDFs over 50MB are compressed in the browser instead.
- Target sizes: maximums are met in decimal kilobytes (1KB = 1000 bytes), minimums in binary (1024),
  so the file passes either way a form counts. A photo below a form's minimum KB is padded without
  changing the picture.
- Pages can be preset by URL. Photo pages: `?resize=` (id-3x4, passport, us-visa, bank-photo, kr-qnet,
  kr-gosi, kr-history, or a longest side like 800) and `?target=` (e.g. 50KB, 200KB, 20-50KB).
  Signature page: `?preset=bank-sign`, `bank-thumb`, `bank-decl`.
- Photo and signature pages also read pasted form instructions ("140 x 60 pixels, 10 KB to 20 KB, JPG")
  and set the size for you.

## PDF tools

- [Free PDF Compressor — Compress & Shrink PDF Online](https://pdfslimio.com/): Free online PDF compressor. Shrink your PDF in seconds while text stays sharp and selectable — or hit an exact size like 100KB or 1MB. No install, no signup.
- [Free PDF Merger — Combine PDF Files Online](https://pdfslimio.com/merge.html): Free online PDF merger. Combine multiple PDF files into one in seconds. No signup, no install, runs in your browser — your files never leave your device.
- [Free PDF Splitter — Split & Extract PDF Pages](https://pdfslimio.com/split.html): Split a PDF into single pages or extract a page range into a new PDF. Free, no signup, no install — runs in your browser, your files stay private.
- [Free Remove PDF Pages — Delete Pages from a PDF](https://pdfslimio.com/delete-pages.html): Free online tool to remove or delete pages from a PDF. Choose which pages to drop and download a smaller PDF in seconds. No signup, no install, runs in your browser.
- [Free PDF Rotator — Rotate PDF Pages](https://pdfslimio.com/rotate.html): Rotate every page of a PDF 90, 180 or 270 degrees. Free, no signup, no install — runs in your browser, so your file never leaves your device.
- [Organize PDF — Reorder, Rotate & Delete Pages Free](https://pdfslimio.com/organize.html): Reorder, rotate or delete PDF pages with a preview of every page. Free, no signup — runs in your browser, so your file never leaves your device.
- [Add Page Numbers to PDF — Free & Online](https://pdfslimio.com/add-page-numbers.html): Add page numbers to a PDF for free. Pick position, format and start number. No signup — runs in your browser, so your file never leaves your device.
- [Watermark PDF — Add Text Watermark Free](https://pdfslimio.com/watermark.html): Add a text watermark like CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT to every page of a PDF. Free, no signup — runs in your browser, your file never leaves your device.
- [Sign PDF — Add Your Signature to a PDF Free](https://pdfslimio.com/sign-pdf.html): Sign a PDF online for free. Draw, type or upload your signature, place it anywhere on any page and download. No signup — runs in your browser.
- [Free PDF to JPG — Convert PDF Pages to Images](https://pdfslimio.com/pdf-to-jpg.html): Free online PDF to JPG converter. Turn every page of a PDF into a high-quality JPG image in seconds. No signup, no install, runs in your browser.
- [Free JPG to PDF — Convert Images to PDF](https://pdfslimio.com/jpg-to-pdf.html): Free online JPG to PDF converter. Turn JPG, PNG and other images into a single PDF in seconds. No signup, no install, runs in your browser.

- [US Visa Photo Tool — 600×600, Under 240KB for DS-160](https://pdfslimio.com/us-visa-photo.html): Make a US visa photo for the DS-160: square 600×600 px JPEG under 240KB, with a head-size and eye-line guide. Free, runs in your browser.
- [Signature Resize to 10–20KB, 140×60 — Paste Your Form’s Rules](https://pdfslimio.com/signature-image.html): Paste the signature rules from your application form (e.g. 140×60 pixels, 10–20KB, 6×2 cm at 300 dpi) and get a clean JPG that fits. Draw it or photograph it on paper. Free, in your browser.
- [IBPS & SBI Photo, Signature, Thumb Impression, Declaration Size Tool](https://pdfslimio.com/bank-exam-photo-signature.html): Resize your bank exam documents to the IBPS / SBI specs: photo 200×230 (20–50KB), signature 140×60 (10–20KB), left thumb impression 240×240 (20–50KB), handwritten declaration 800×400 (50–100KB). Free, in your browser.

## Guides

- [How to compress a PDF without losing quality (and hit an exact size like 100KB)](https://pdfslimio.com/guides/compress-pdf-without-losing-quality.html): Why PDFs get big, what compression actually changes, which settings keep text sharp, and how to get a PDF under a fixed limit like 100KB, 200KB or 1MB without making it unreadable.
- [Photo and signature size for Indian exams: RRB, SSC, UPSC, NEET and IBPS (2026)](https://pdfslimio.com/guides/india-exam-photo-signature-size.html): The official photo and signature upload rules for RRB NTPC, SSC, UPSC, NEET and IBPS/SBI in one table — KB range, pixels and the mistakes that get forms rejected — with a free tool preset for each.
- [KB, pixels, cm and DPI: photo size rules on application forms, explained](https://pdfslimio.com/guides/kb-pixels-cm-dpi-explained.html): What "3.5 × 4.5 cm", "200 × 230 pixels", "200 DPI" and "20–50KB" each mean on an application form, how to convert between them, and why a photo can be the right size in pixels but the wrong size in KB.
- [How to make a clean signature image for online forms (JPG 10–20KB or transparent PNG)](https://pdfslimio.com/guides/signature-image-for-online-forms.html): Turn a signature on paper into a clean JPG that passes exam and job portals (10–20KB, 140 × 60 px and similar) or a transparent PNG for signing documents — how to photograph it, clean it and size it.
- [원서·시험 사진 규격 총정리: 큐넷·공무원·한능검·토익·여권 (2026)](https://pdfslimio.com/ko/guides/exam-application-photo-size.html): 큐넷, 국가직 공무원, 한국사능력검정시험, 토익, 여권 온라인 신청의 사진 규격(cm·픽셀·용량·형식)을 공식 안내 기준으로 한 표에 정리하고, 픽셀 계산법과 반려되는 사진 유형까지 설명해요.
- [PDF 용량 줄이기 원리: 글자는 선명하게, 용량만 줄이는 법](https://pdfslimio.com/ko/guides/pdf-compression-explained.html): PDF가 왜 무거운지, 압축하면 무엇이 바뀌고 무엇이 그대로인지, 글자를 선명하게 두면서 100KB·500KB·1MB 같은 정해진 용량에 맞추는 방법을 원리부터 정리했어요.
